content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

Aim for about 1.6–2.2 g of protein per kg of body weight per day. Going above that doesn't hurt, but it doesn't add much either. 💪 For example, at 80 kg that's roughly 130–175 g a day.

Spread it over 3–5 meals, with about 0.3–0.4 g/kg each. Also make sure you're eating enough total calories, since a small surplus matters just as much for your 100 kg bench goal. Ain't nothin' but a peanut!
